note: _affluet_ (Clementina, Weber/Gryson). This is the correct reading; the Benedictine Vulgate (1972) misprints the word as _afluet_, which would mean “flow off; wegfließen” – the opposite of what is actually meant. – Herbert Migsch: _Affluet_ oder _afluet_ Jer 30,0 Vulg: ein Druckfehler im Text der römischen Vulgata. _Biblische Notizen_ 173 (2017) 101–103. – The Nova Vulgata has a different wording; the phrase _et cunctis affluet bonis_ – and abound with all good things (Douay Version) – does not figure in the passage.
